terms.method: Unicode letters/marks/numbers; NFC+casefold, no stopwords; document frequency, not validated aspects. Contact-like strings redacted; minimum document frequency applied. Selected product-related terms use an English diagnostic lexicon, not an exhaustive multilingual aspect taxonomy.

products.identity_basis: exact-name product_group proxy; true unique catalog-product count unavailable
products.threshold_note: A starting evidence floor, not proof of reliable ranking; validate with learning curves, independent customers, deduplication sensitivity and uncertainty intervals.

exact_duplicates.canonical_note: Secondary screen drops punctuation, emojis, one-character and numeric-only tokens. It may group unrelated short phrases; overlap is not proof of the same customer review.

bounded_near_duplicates.method: Seeded per-split bounded sample; Unicode-token character-five-gram MinHash LSH (candidate threshold .75), then exact Jaccard. Independent normalization differs from Phase 1.
bounded_near_duplicates.limitation: Sampling and LSH can miss overlaps; no semantic paraphrase or exhaustive all-pairs claim.

geography.note: India-marketplace provenance is retained; customer residence cannot be established.

verified_issues: Source count: 1; absent target categories: smartphones, tvs_monitors.
Entirely missing metadata fields: product_id, review_date, verified_purchase, helpful_votes.
Supplied language labels and rating-derived overall sentiment are not independently verified annotations.
potential_risks: Similar product names/variants can leak across exact-name groups.
Short generic text and approximate similarity matching do not establish independent customers.
Whole-dataset EDA exposes holdout distributions: reserve a new independent final test set for future confirmatory evaluation.
unverified_assumptions: Individual customer geography, independent reviewer identities and marketplace-original text cannot be verified.

validation.product_identity_basis: exact-name product_group proxy; no verified catalog identities

split_reproduction.method: Recompute original assignment and duplicate quarantine on existing Phase 1 candidates; compare all retained IDs and split labels

validation.scope: Schema/value/source-ID/exact-name-group checks; passing does not prove semantic or catalog-identity leakage absence
